name: Project Status Report
description: Status of a whole project from all its meetings: progress, decisions, open and overdue actions, risks and next steps.

sections.title: Status Summary
sections.instruction: In one paragraph, summarise where the project stands today based on all its meetings, oldest to newest. Mention the date range covered.

sections.title: Progress by Meeting
sections.instruction: For each meeting, in date order, give its title, date and the main progress or outcome in one or two bullets.

sections.title: Decisions to Date
sections.instruction: List the decisions recorded across the meetings, newest first, with the meeting date for each.

sections.title: Open Actions
sections.instruction: List the open action items with owner and due date exactly as recorded ('not stated' when missing). Put OVERDUE items first and mark them.

sections.title: Risks and Blockers
sections.instruction: List the risks, blockers and unresolved questions that appear in the meetings. Write 'None recorded' if there are none.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List what is planned next, based on the latest meetings.
